title: What Is Tenant Representation? A Guide for Newcastle Businesses

metaDescription: Learn what a tenant representative does for Newcastle businesses, how engagement fees are agreed and how commercial leasing support works alongside your solicitor.
body:
A tenant representative supports the business taking a commercial lease. For Newcastle and Hunter businesses, the work can connect the premises brief, property search, comparison of commercial terms and negotiation before a new lease or renewal is agreed. Your solicitor advises on legal terms and documentation.

Your Office Space provides tenant-side representation in NSW under an agreed engagement. The right scope depends on whether you are searching, renewing, comparing premises or considering a move.

## What does a tenant representative do?

The starting point is your business brief: activities, people, access, location, budget and timing. The tenant representative can use that brief to organise a search, compare options and coordinate the commercial negotiation workstream.

- Define the property requirements and practical constraints.
- Compare premises and proposed occupancy costs on a consistent basis.
- Discuss rent, incentives, reviews and other commercial priorities.
- Coordinate information and decisions with your appointed advisers.
- Connect the premises decision with fit out, furniture and moving requirements where relevant.

Those tasks depend on the agreed appointment. Representation does not guarantee savings, incentives or a particular lease outcome.

## How is this different from a landlord's leasing agent?

A landlord's leasing agent acts for the property owner in the transaction. A tenant representative is appointed to support the tenant's brief and commercial decision. Before engaging anyone, confirm whom they represent, their scope, fees and any relevant third-party arrangements.

Do not assume the role from the person who shows you a property. Ask how the appointment works and what authority you are giving them.

[Compare tenant representation and a leasing agent](/blog/tenant-rep-vs-leasing-agent-newcastle)

## How much does tenant representation cost?

Fees depend on the engagement and transaction structure. Ask for the proposed scope, fee basis, payment timing, exclusions and relevant third-party arrangements before work begins. A published example or another client's arrangement does not establish the fee for your project.

YOS confirms the engagement terms before starting. We do not promise that negotiated benefits will exceed the fee or that the engagement will pay for itself within a fixed period.

## What can be negotiated in a commercial lease?

Commercial discussions may cover rent, incentives, reviews, outgoings, options and end-of-lease obligations. What is available depends on the property, parties, lease and negotiation. Compare the full proposal rather than assuming that a lower headline rent produces the better overall option.

Have your solicitor review the proposed wording and legal obligations before you commit. Commercial negotiation support complements that advice.

[Read the commercial lease comparison guide](/blog/how-to-compare-commercial-leases)

## When should a Newcastle business start the conversation?

Start while there is time to define the brief and investigate alternatives. Record the lease expiry and any option or notice dates, and ask your solicitor to confirm what they require. If the deadline is close, explain that at the first discussion so the scope reflects the available time.

You can discuss renewal as well as relocation. Assess whether the current premises still work for the business alongside the proposed terms and the practical cost of moving.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can a tenant representative help with a renewal?

Yes. A renewal brief can assess the existing premises, proposed commercial terms and practical alternatives. The approach depends on the lease, business needs and timing.

### Does tenant representation replace legal advice?

No. Your appointed solicitor advises on legal terms and documentation. YOS coordinates the agreed tenant-side commercial workstream.

### Are rent-free periods or fit out contributions guaranteed?

No. Incentives depend on the property, parties and negotiated terms. Do not build an approval budget around an incentive that has not been agreed and documented.

### Does YOS work beyond Newcastle?

YOS is Newcastle-based and provides tenant representation across NSW within the agreed service scope. Each brief is assessed against its location and requirements.

## Prepare your brief and discuss the next step

Bring the location, lease timing, space requirements and the decision you need to make. Flag uncertain budget or timing inputs so they can be resolved with the appropriate people.
